description: Folds a position onto a small patch of the plane, either a square tile or a wedge, which repeats a picture as a grid or as a kaleidoscope

params.text: Picks the shape folded onto: Square maps every square of a grid onto the one at the origin, Radial maps every wedge onto the one starting at zero degrees
Sets how many sections the plane is cut into, 1 to 11
Blends the amount away from the knob and towards the amount jack; at the far left it is all knob, at the far right all jack

inputs.text: Channel 1 is the horizontal position and channel 2 the vertical; patching this leaves the separate X and Y jacks unread
The horizontal position to fold; it is unread while the two-channel position jack has a cable in it
The vertical position to fold; it is unread while the two-channel position jack has a cable in it
Sets the number of sections when the modulation knob is turned up, one volt above the voltage here being the number of sections

outputs.text: Channel 1 carries the folded horizontal position and channel 2 the folded vertical one

notes: the amount is not scaled to a section count, so the jack and the knob read on different scales: the knob counts 1 to 11 and the jack counts the voltage plus one

inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the amount knob's own setting.
